The beautiful part is that, one, you found out about it, so there’s someone who can be there for them. That’s beautiful. So they’re not in this alone—it’s beautiful. Getting to actually affect a change. Like, if we are fortunate enough to come up with good solutions or we have enough money to help a situation, then what a privilege it is to be of service…
